summary.intent: Execute and iteratively gap-close Phase 68.1 (web client runtime integration) using GSD's wave-based parallel execution and plan-phase workflows, then diagnose e2e/web-app bugs the user found manually.
summary.outcome: 14 initial plans plus 8 gap-closure plans executed across multiple waves; e2e pass rate improved from 6/208 to ~200/208 over iterations; several real bugs were found and fixed (folder-store id desync, kind-cache wiring gaps, TEE republish enrollment, D-05 stale-record toast, text-editor decrypt key misuse) and multiple new gaps documented (GAP-1/2/4/5/6, enumerateSharedSubtree empty picker); the session ended hitting the account quota mid-exit-gate, requiring manual recovery of uncommitted test-fixture fixes before committing and re-verifying.

repo: GSD executor subagents can silently stall/lose their wake signal after backgrounding long-running commands (e.g. full e2e suites) — the orchestrator must watch for lost completion signals and resume the agent via SendMessage rather than assuming a freeze means still-running.

Serial Playwright describe blocks abort at first failure, so a 'N failed / 208' tally understates real breakage — later sections of a serial spec never execute, hiding bugs (text-editor decrypt bug was invisible until cold-reload/nested-folder fixes let the suite run deeper).

mock-ipns-routing dev container keeps IPNS records in an in-memory Map; any restart wipes records that lack a DB-backed republish registration, manifesting as permanent cold-navigation 404s for folders created before the TEE-enrollment fix.

The mock-ipns-routing healthcheck used `wget localhost` which resolves to ::1 while the app binds IPv4-only, causing perpetual 'unhealthy' status unrelated to actual service health — fixed to 127.0.0.1 in docker-compose.yml.
API listens on :3000; :3001 is the separate mock delegated-routing service — probing :3001 to check API health gives false negatives.
sdk-core's `updateFileMetadata` had a latent bug where it never actually zeroed `fileIpnsPrivateKey` despite doc comments claiming it did.
GSD decision-coverage gate requires the `[informational]` tag to be placed inside the bold ID group, e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**`, not elsewhere in the bullet.

migration `1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover` dropped the `shares` table's plaintext `item_name` column entirely, making the REQ-4 itemName backfill feature permanently dead code (share.service.ts hardcodes `itemName: ''`) — reviving it would violate the zero-knowledge architecture rule.

code.finding: hardcoded `isFolder = true` meant the D-02 kind cache populated in 68.1-14 was never consulted in the shared browser, causing files to render/behave as folders

downloadFromIpns fed the parent folderKey into sdk-core's resolveFileMetadata instead of the file's own readKey (recovered via unsealChildReadKey from the SealedChildRef), causing AEAD decrypt failure in the text editor/preview specifically (download/preview paths used a different, correct route)
final uncommitted file modified in the session — part of exit-gate GAP-2 cold-reload retry-budget fix for subfolder navigation after logout/login

workflow: When a background subagent is driving a long-running test suite and 'ends its turn' to wait, arm an independent watchdog (poll for the completion artifact file) rather than trusting the agent's own resume — agents can lose their wake/session and never re-trigger, especially near session/quota limits.

Verifying a subagent's self-reported `expected_base`/worktree metadata against actual git state (`git merge-base`) before recording it is worth doing — agents can misreport their own HEAD as the fork base.
When a post-merge test gate fails, don't trust a truncated `tail`-based check for exit code — re-run capturing the real exit status before concluding pass/fail.

Root-causing test/fixture regressions after a contract change (e.g., new required key fields) by reading the actual mock/fixture shape against the new call site, rather than just re-running, isolates fixture-only fixes from product-code regressions.
Live progress into a backgrounded task's captured stdout can be read directly from the task's log/capture file when the normal progress counter isn't otherwise queryable.

friction: Wave-1 executor agent stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 min) requiring a spot-check + resume rather than trusting the stream.

Exit-gate agent's completion signal was lost twice in a row (once after the first full e2e run, once after a shared triage run) — orchestrator had to detect via watchdog/process checks and manually resume via SendMessage each time.
A subagent (68.1-16) ran a prohibited `git stash push`/never popped it during a mid-task recovery, leaving a stray stash entry that had to be identified and dropped during cleanup.
git index.lock transient contention during Wave 3 tracking commit required a retry.
Bash tool call denied (likely reading .env) mid dev-stack diagnosis, forcing a workaround split into separate commands.

Exit-gate agent ultimately died mid-task on an account session-limit cutoff, leaving uncommitted test-fixture fixes and a SUMMARY that had to be manually recovered, validated, and committed by the orchestrator.
mock-ipns-routing's misconfigured healthcheck (IPv6 vs IPv4 localhost) caused it to appear perpetually unhealthy despite functioning correctly, consuming diagnostic time.
open_items: GAP-1 (resolveFileMetadata AEAD failure for CTR video/batch-download) and its text-editor variant needed a fix threading SealedChildRef/unsealChildReadKey — fix was in progress at session end via the recovered exit-gate work.
GAP-2 cold-reload subfolder navigation retry-budget fix (useFolderNavigation.ts) was applied but final e2e confirmation run was cut off by the quota limit.
GAP-6: REQ-4 itemName backfill is dead code post-schema-cutover (item_name column dropped) — needs an explicit product decision (retire feature vs. redesign) rather than a unilateral code fix.
enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) still rides the now-empty share_keys fan-out and always returns an empty list — documented as a follow-up gap, not fixed.

Old folders/files created before the fileReadKey seal fix and TEE-enrollment fix have permanently dead/mis-sealed IPNS records in the dev vault — user was warned these are data damage, not code bugs, and need manual recreation.
Final phase re-verification (gsd-verifier round 2) was launched but its result was not yet observed before the transcript ends.

docker-compose.yml healthcheck fix and stray stash cleanup were committed but should be confirmed as part of final PR review (parenthesized commit subjects 17e4319a6/7209e8777 flagged to keep out of PR title).
